label: System
title: System Settings
subtitle: Application-level controls for updates and system behaviour.
description: The System tab contains controls that affect the entire InnoviumAI installation. These settings are typically configured once during initial setup and are normally managed by an administrator.

settings.name: Update Server
settings.description: Switch between production (stable releases) and development (pre-release builds). Changing this affects which updates are offered.

settings.name: Check for Updates
settings.description: Manually trigger an update check. If a new version is available, you can download and apply it from this panel.

mediaCaption: The System tab showing the update server toggle and a check-for-updates button
tips: Stay on the production update server unless you are testing pre-release features — development builds may be unstable.
Administrators can lock the update server setting at the profile level to prevent users from switching to development builds.
